title: CmdPal: Refine superseding value gate lifecycle

status.label: Manual review required at review limit
status.detail: The eighth and final automated review returned five comments. All were source-adjudicated, replied to and resolved; no supported author-facing defect remains from that pass. There is no fresh zero-comment review, and exact-target builds and tests have not run. Earlier review-only alternatives are not established upstream defects. This is not an approval or an author-waiting state.

next_action: A maintainer must manually adjudicate the pinned source and retained review alternatives, record the review decision, and complete any required exact-tree validation. Do not request a ninth automated review or reset the round count.

blockers.detail: The lifetime eight-round automated review limit has been reached without a fresh substantive zero-comment pass. All five comments from the final review were adjudicated and resolved, but that does not establish convergence. Builds and tests remain unrun; no approval is offered.
blockers.remediation: A maintainer must manually review the current upstream source and retained review alternatives, decide which changes are justified, and record a manual review result with required exact-tree validation. Routine local validation remains authorized under the existing build gates; no additional automated review request is permitted.
